   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 06.05.2026 - 14.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Jessica Cahanin_, 14.10.2026, 1/5: "The updates suck, the app glitches regularly, and they continually taking features away from the free app to put it behind the paywall to make you purchase their *premium* version. It stinks because I've used this app for close to 15 years for tracking my meals but will now be looking for a different app and slowly transitioning all of my saved recipes and meals somewhere else. I don't mind the ads for using a free app, but taking away the features that I've been using is my final straw."
            2. _Kai Raphael_, 11.10.2026, 1/5: "app is suddenly really slow"
            3. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30.08.2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
